The topic of non-compliance within the ADHD treatment corpus reveals systemic failures to meet established clinical standards across both public and private healthcare providers. A major area of concern is the performance related to [[Indikator 3]]. According to the 2023 data, there was a complete lack of compliance at the regional level, with no regions meeting the required standard for this indicator [^src1]. This systemic shortfall extended to the departmental level as well, where not a single department managed to fulfill the standard for [[Indikator 3]] [^src1].

Non-compliance is also evident in the private healthcare sector. When examining specific treatment initiatives, the 2024 data highlights a stark deficiency in patient education efforts at [[Privathospitaler]]. Specifically, none of the patients treated at private hospitals were registered as having begun ADHD psychoeducation [^src2]. Together, these findings illustrate a widespread inability to adhere to critical ADHD treatment protocols and quality indicators across the entire healthcare system.
